markets_business.ipo: NGX listing activity is thin and not covered by the global IPO trackers. The World Bank listed-company count in the historical charts is the usable long-run series.
markets_business.note: Nigeria is the one market here where the free equity-index providers carry no usable NGX All-Share series, so the live market panel shows it as unavailable rather than guessing.

global.ipo: Global IPO proceeds tripled year on year in H1 2026, from $58.2bn to $178bn across 524 deals (up from 490). The concentration is extreme: the top 10 were almost all US, almost all AI-adjacent.
themes: Tariffs are the shared shock. They read as inflation in the US, as a growth and labour hit in Canada, and as a tax-base risk in Ireland.
Four of the five central banks are on hold. Nigeria is the outlier on level (26.5%) and the only one with disinflation as its main story rather than sticky inflation.
Energy prices from the Middle East conflict have pushed up the 2026 inflation forecast in Europe.
